settings.heading: Submit a Warranty Claim
settings.description: Please fill out the form below and our team will review your claim within 2–3 business days. Have your order number and product details ready before submitting.
settings.placeholder_product: e.g. ORI Strut Kit – Ford Ranger PX3
settings.placeholder_description: Please describe the issue in detail, including when it occurred and any relevant conditions.
settings.photo_link_hint: Upload photos to Google Drive or Dropbox and paste the shared link here.

settings.title: What products are covered under warranty?
settings.content: All ORI Offroad Industries products are covered against manufacturing defects for the duration of the stated warranty period from the original purchase date. Please refer to your product documentation or contact our team for specific warranty terms.

settings.title: How long does it take to process a warranty claim?
settings.content: Our team aims to review and respond to all warranty claims within 2–3 business days. Complex claims requiring physical inspection may take longer. We will keep you updated throughout the process.

settings.title: What information do I need to submit a claim?
settings.content: You will need your order number, the product name or SKU, the date of purchase, and a description of the issue. Photos of the defect or damage are strongly recommended and can be shared via a Google Drive or Dropbox link.

settings.title: Does warranty cover installation damage?
settings.content: Warranty does not cover damage resulting from incorrect installation, misuse, modification, or normal wear and tear. We recommend having products installed by a qualified professional. If you are unsure whether your claim is covered, submit the form and our team will assess it.

settings.title: My item arrived damaged. What should I do?
settings.content: If your item arrived damaged in transit, please submit a warranty claim and select "Shipping Damage" as the claim type. Include photos of the packaging and the damaged item. Claims for shipping damage should be submitted within 48 hours of delivery.
